text:
Hi Brian, the queue manager epic is set up. ZOM-543 has 10 children (ZOM-585 to ZOM-594), and all 39 reports are lines under them: Vincent's 38 rows plus Marcus's pass icon glow bug from my DMs. The stock-take sheet is in my ZM queue manager folder, shared with everyone on the review invite, and the numbers slide is at the end of the queue manager deck.

The numbers:
• Passed: 12
• Waiting on QA: 6
• Waiting on a fix: 21
• Areas clear: 1 (Zombie Lane)
• On the review list: 6 (Collect & Win and Level-end rewards)

A few calls you might want to check:
• Tutorial rows 1, 2 and 25 (boss arena tutorial): Vincent's ok was on iOS Internal #1718, which was a QueueManager branch build. Under Arthur's rule that doesn't count, so they're Waiting on QA (#465 is merged).
• Rows 9 (pass popup over the daily gift) and 29 (Endless intro replay) passed on main, but both were reported back on Android Submission #135, so they're Waiting on a fix again.
• #472 doesn't fix ZOM-571 and #475 doesn't fix ZOM-581, per Arthur's review, so both went back to Todo. Oliver's comment on #473 covers ZOM-572 and the pass bar row, so those are In Validation.
• Rows 11 and 20 already had tickets (ZOM-556 and ZOM-560), so I used those.
The new tickets have no priority or assignee, for you to set.
